# MathJax vendor asset

`tex-svg.js` is the MathJax TeX-to-SVG browser component used by
`../../../geodetic-ecef-coordinates-teaching.html` to render LaTeX formulas
inside the standalone teaching document.

Source URL used to vendor this file:

```text
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3/es5/tex-svg.js
```

The bundled MathJax component reports MathJax version `3.2.2`.
MathJax is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.
